name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Notte: Web Automation Framework for AI Agents
short_description: Notte is a powerful framework designed for building web agents and deploying serverless web automation functions on a reliable browser infrastructure. It streamlines the automation process, making it easier for developers to create efficient web solutions.
author: nottelabs

sections.overview:
Notte is a framework designed to streamline the development and deployment of web agents and serverless web automation functions. It provides reliable browser infrastructure for developers to build efficient web solutions without managing underlying infrastructure. The framework simplifies the automation process by handling deployment and browser management, allowing developers to focus on defining their automation logic. Notte supports building automated workflows that interact with web pages, making it suitable for web scraping, testing, and workflow automation use cases.
Automate the extraction of data from e-commerce websites for market analysis.
Create interactive web agents that assist users in navigating complex web applications.
Deploy serverless functions to handle web scraping tasks on a schedule.
Enhance user experience by automating form submissions and data entry on web platforms.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install nottelabs/notte`
`git clone https://github.com/nottelabs/notte`
sections.usage:
```
Create a web agent using Notte to automate the process of monitoring and purchasing domain names for [COMPANY]. The agent should track the price of [DOMAIN] and notify the team when the price drops below [THRESHOLD]. Additionally, the agent should be able to make an offer on the domain through the [PLATFORM] website.
```
Copy

```
The web agent has been successfully created using Notte. It will monitor the price of Automa.com on the Atom.com platform. The agent is set to notify the team when the price drops below $200,000. The agent can also make an offer on the domain through the Atom.com website. The agent will run daily and provide updates on the domain's price and any changes in its availability.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
